text: This clip shows the owner emailing an invoice, and the customer paying it by card.
The owner emails the invoice from the system. The message comes from a template they can edit, with the PDF attached and a pay-by-card link. Replies go to the owner's inbox.
The customer gets the email from OTC Fleet Graphix, with the PDF attached. They click pay by card.
A simple payment page takes their card. There is nothing to sign in to.
Back in the app, the invoice is marked paid and the balance is zero. The payment shows on the invoices list too.
